dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: What's this Iro... Irodory Festival thing again? What's it supposed to be?

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: And there's a ton of people here too. I must admit that it's got me a little muddle-headed.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: Still, it's good to see our pampered Lady do work out there, so I suppose I can't complain.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: ...What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: I am Sasaki, a subordinate of the Kanjou Commissioner.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: ...A reminder for you, if you have any impudent ideas concerning Miss Hiiragi, you'd best watch out for the blade in my hands.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: Bye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Miss Hiiragi?

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: As a daughter that he had in his old age, the Commissioner dotes on Miss Hiiragi. He even requested that a Chief Samurai such as myself be her personal bodyguard.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: Heh... If I must be frank, that's truly a waste of my great talents.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: That being said, since it's an order from the Commissioner, I shall still do my utmost.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: Hmph, I've heard that many young punks inside the Commission have also been harboring mischievous thoughts about Miss Hiiragi...

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: ...No matter who it may be, I, Sasaki, shall not show any mercy if he oversteps his bounds.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: ...What is it?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: I am Sasaki, a subordinate of the Kanjou Commissioner. I am present in charge of our Lady's security.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: Presently, she is a key member of the Kanjou Commission, so I cannot afford to be lax. Not in the slightest.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's Hiiragi Chisato doing?

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: After that whole hullabaloo, she seems to have completely changed, and has taken to settling the clan's affairs with great drive.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: She has taken up all the things that would be the Commissioner's duties, and she has performed very well indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Sasaki
dialogues.text: She is very talented, this much I can tell. Though road ahead may be long... But I'm glad that she took this step forward.
